description: Before paying an x402 seller through the non-custodial MoneyTools Pay Gateway: prechecks the seller (valid x402 terms, OFAC-screened payTo) and returns the gateway URL to call, the price and the gateway fee (max(0.5% of price, $0.001), charged from prepaid credits only when the seller answers 2xx). Your own wallet always pays the seller directly; the gateway never holds or signs funds. Then call gatewayUrl with header X-API-Key using any x402 client. Free to try: 20 MCP calls/day per client, no API key or wallet needed (beyond that: prepaid credits via header X-API-Key, see server instructions).
